confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from partly dated web sources (2023 to 2026) and several differ, so they are bounded estimates. Beer is the best-covered anchor. Coffee is weaker, and cocktail and wine rest on 2023-2025 UK averages adjusted upward. Restaurant anchors are approximate and the midrange meal assumes no drinks. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. GBP converted to USD at an assumed 1.34 USD per GBP, since no dated October 2026 GBP/USD rate was found. The FX observation was taken from RBA table snippets in search results, not from a directly opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized English university city with strong tourist demand, using UK-wide 2025-2026 pub and restaurant averages and reported Cambridge-versus-London differences (Cambridge is generally a few percent cheaper than London). Wine glass is anchored to a UK average glass of wine and a sparkling wine benchmark, adjusted upward for restaurant markup and inflation. Accommodation uses general knowledge of Cambridge's summer room rates, which are typically high.
